test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Meenu alone can do a work in 16 days. Simi alone can do it in 12 days. If Raj joins them, they three together can complete the work in 4 days. How long will Raj alone take to finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Meenu alone can do the work in 16 days.

Simi alone can do the work in 12 days.

They three together can complete the work in 4 days.

**Formula used:**

Work rate of Meenu = (1)/(16) work/day

Work rate of Simi = (1)/(12) work/day

Work rate of Raj = (1)/(R) work/day

Combined work rate = (1)/(4) work/day

**Calculations:**

Combined work rate = Work rate of Meenu + Work rate of Simi + Work rate of Raj

(1)/(4) = (1)/(16) + (1)/(12) + (1)/(R) 

⇒ (1)/(R) = (1)/(4) - (1)/(16) - (1)/(12) 

⇒ (1)/(R) = (1)/(4) - (1)/(16) - (1)/(12) 

⇒ (1)/(R) = (12 - 3 - 4)/(48) 

⇒ (1)/(R) = (5)/(48) 

⇒ R = (48)/(5) days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
